item.title: SpaceX is stuck in a difficult adolescence
item.description: The $2 trln company’s server-rental unit grew 800%, but attractive returns will probably fade as chip shortages subside. Rockets are boss Elon Musk’s durable advantage, but mostly as a way to support the next big thing. AI, wireless networks, chipmaking or even cars beckon.
item.dc:creator: Robert Cyran
item.content:encoded: What will SpaceX (SPCX.O) be when it grows up? The limitless possibility of a long-prolonged corporate adolescence supported the rocket, satellite network and artificial intelligence company’s ascent to a $2 trillion valuation. Results released on Tuesday highlight the quick returns boss Elon Musk has gleaned from opportunistically expanding into new areas like renting out chips for chatbots. Yet that business could soon erode, leaving the impulsive CEO to search out yet another focus from the many available. SpaceX said that its AI and server-rental unit – renamed to “Super Intelligence,” following President Donald Trump’s preferred terminology – generated an astonishing $7.6 billion of revenue in the third quarter, an 829% increase from last year. This surprise success was the product of arrested development: Musk wanted to run a top AI lab, yet his Grok bot’s also-ran status left its data centers underused. More-popular rivals like Anthropic conversely face a shortage, and paid top dollar to get chips now. This happy accident is now SpaceX’s biggest business line, overtaking its original core focus of putting satellites into orbit with reusable rockets. Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen boasted in September that incremental investment in Super Intelligence pays back [USN:L6N45T0Y8 TEXT:"rapidly"], and so the company has said that it could increase capacity perhaps five-fold by the end of next year. High returns, however, stem from chip shortages, which have lifted rental prices above where they were last year. Markets seem to expect this situation to wane: the price to rent out Nvidia GB300 silicon is about $10 an hour for the next several months, analysts at MoffettNathanson estimated, but only $4 further in the future. If AI demand is lower than expected, or chief clients like Anthropic are stretched too thin, prices could plummet lower. If becoming a cloud operator is just an adolescent phase for SpaceX, then what’s next? There’s always enterprise software, like the promised “Macrohard,” an AI platform to augment workers. The company’s satellite broadband business threatens to take on [USN:L6N4511C3 TEXT:"wireless networks"] worldwide. And SpaceX is building a $17 billion, 100-million-square foot plant for fabricating semiconductors with partner Tesla (TSLA.O) . If Musk chose to [USN:L6N42B10Y TEXT:"jam together"] the two companies fully, cars and robots are added to the menu. Rockets, ironically, fade into obscurity. Revenue for SpaceX’s namesake business grew only 6% compared to last year. It is simply too small to justify such a wild valuation, which was 94 times estimated earnings over the next year before quarterly figures were released. Yet the company [USN:L6N41315K TEXT:"dominates the market"] for putting stuff into orbit, while electric vehicles are beset by rising Chinese rivals, some 200 companies build AI data centers for hire, and countless robot developers pop up. Endless opportunity beckons, just not in the places where SpaceX is actually mature. Follow Robert Cyran on Bluesky . SpaceX said on October 20 that it generated $14.6 billion of revenue in the third quarter, compared to $5.6 billion in the same period a year prior. The company’s Super Intelligence segment produced revenue of $7.6 billion, up from $813 million a year ago. The company earned $4.4 billion of net income, as opposed to a $1.1 billion loss a year ago. Capital expenditures nearly tripled to $19.6 billion, as the company invested $16.4 billion in Super Intelligence. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: Trading Day: Oil reversal lifts spirits
item.description: US stocks rose on Tuesday, shrugging off global weakness earlier in the day as oil prices pulled back sharply from six-month highs, a reversal that also pushed longer-dated Treasury yields lower. Shares in SpaceX spiked 3% in post-market trading after the release of third-quarter results.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
[USN:L6N4660K8 TEXT:"US stocks"] rose on Tuesday, shrugging off global weakness earlier in the day as [USN:L4N46600B TEXT:"oil"] prices pulled back sharply from six-month highs, a reversal that also pushed longer-dated Treasury yields lower. Shares in [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"SpaceX"] spiked 3% in post-market trading after the release of third-quarter results. In my column today , I suggest emerging markets may be more resilient to rising US interest rates and market volatility than they have been for years. They're not immune, of course, but higher yields, manageable debt, and stronger policy credibility will help them weather any incoming storms. Today's Key Reads [USN:S8N42Q0F9 TEXT:"France to deploy troops, admits to failures over weekend unrest"] [USN:L6N45Z0Q9 TEXT:"Europe's earnings boom widens beyond energy and AI"] [USN:L6N46514Y TEXT:"Markets' squeal is music to Fed ears — but still too faint: Mike Dolan"] [USN:P8N42A06D TEXT:"South Korean firm's debut plunge adds to investor concerns about AI spending"] [USN:AZN4TPYV6 TEXT:"China leaves loan rates steady for 17th consecutive month"] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Asia in the red: South Korea -3.5%, Japan -1.5%. [USN:L6N4660GA TEXT:"Europe"] slips, France lags. Americas in the green: Brazil +1.5%, Dow +1%, S&P 500 +0.3%, Nasdaq flat, small-cap Russell 2000 index +1.7%, biggest rise since August 4. SECTORS/SHARES: Nine sectors on the S&P 500 rise, two fall. Healthcare +2.3%, comms services -0.9%. Biggest gainers on S&P 500 Equifax, [USN:L4N4660MX TEXT:"Hasbro"] +11%; biggest decliner [USN:L6N4660OJ TEXT:"General Motors"] -7%. [USN:L6N465197 TEXT:"Netflix"] -6% after the bell. FX: Dollar down broadly. Biggest G10 climbers are [USN:L6N4660NK TEXT:"sterling"] to five-week high, [USN:L6N46613B TEXT:"Canadian dollar"] to one-month high. [USN:L1N46608R TEXT:"Colombian peso"] biggest decliner. BONDS: Japanese yields slide, French yields dip but spread over bunds has widest close since 2011. French CDS highest since 2013. US yields -5 bps at long end, +2 bps at short end. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L4N46600B TEXT:"Oil"] hits six-month high, then closes lower: Brent -0.7%, WTI -1.8%.

Today's Talking Points: Crude to go? Markets and economies around the world are taking the global energy shock in their stride, but if that's because they're expecting prices to fall any time soon, they may have to readjust. Oil prices closed lower on Tuesday, but not before Brent and WTI crude futures clocked fresh six-month peaks — Brent nudged $112/barrel and WTI rose above $110. It seems a lifetime ago, but when the US and Iran signed the MOU in June, an end to the war, opening of the Strait of Hormuz, and replenishing of global energy supplies seemed imminent. WTI's year-on-year price change even briefly turned negative. But now, WTI is nearly 80% more expensive than it was a year ago and inflationary pressures, although supply-driven, are increasingly difficult for policymakers to look through. Will today's reported [USN:S8N455017 TEXT:"Iran-Pakistan talks"] open the door to a US-Iran detente? Get off of my (neo)cloud To America's [USN:L4N461208 TEXT:"CoreWeave"], Nebius, and Iren, you can now add South Korea's [USN:P8N42A06D TEXT:"Elice"]. These are some of the "neocloud" firms at the heart of the AI buildout that are making headlines. Unfortunately, often for the wrong reasons. The shares and, where applicable, the bonds of these companies are getting crushed on fears that their huge borrowing and spending commitments won't pay off. Elice shares debuted in Seoul on Tuesday and plunged 32%, the worst debut ever in South Korea for a company that raised more than $100 million in an IPO. Iren shares have lost almost 50% in the past month, CoreWeave and Nebius have both fallen 35% in two weeks. Testing times, but UBS analysts are more sanguine. "A financially stressed neocloud could still own economically valuable assets... That is why we need to look beyond any individual neocloud and examine the broader demand picture." Which, they say, remains robust. 20-year itch If yields are high enough, investors will want a piece of them. Japan's 20-year government bond yield nudged 4% earlier this month, the highest in more than 30 years for that maturity, and Tuesday's 20-year JGB auction was flooded with record demand — the bid-to-cover ratio was 5.84, the highest since 20-year JGBs were first sold in 1987. On Wednesday, the US Treasury sells $13 billion of 20-year bonds. Demand won't be anywhere near as strong, with the BTC ratio at auctions over the past year ranging between 2.36 and 2.86, according to Wrightson ICAP. It could even be one of the last 20-year auctions, as speculation mounts that Treasury could scrap them as part of its push to shorten the maturity profile of the debt. What could move markets tomorrow? Japan trade (September) [USN:L4N464025 TEXT:"Indonesia"] interest rate decision UK CPI, PPI inflation (September) US Treasury sells $13 billion of 20-year bonds at auction US earnings including Meta, Tesla, IBM Want to receive Trading Day in your inbox every weekday morning? Sign up for my newsletter here . Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: ウィットコフ米特使、21日にプーチン氏と会談 ウクライナ新提案協議＝米当局者
item.description: [ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は２１日にロシアのプーチン大統領と会談する。米当局者が２０日、明らかにした。

ウィットコフ氏は２０日、ノルウェーの首都オスロでウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と会談。米当局者によると、ウクライナはオスロでの協議で新たな構想や提案を提示した。プーチン氏との会談では、ウクライナや欧州との協議で得られた進展を土台に、これらの提案について協議することが目的だという。

同当局者は、ウクライナ、欧州、米国の間で今後の対応を巡り、実務レベルで強い足並みの一致が実現していると指摘。オスロでの協議で、ロシアとの和平実現後にロシアによる再侵攻を防ぐためのウクライナに対する「安全保障の保証」を含む包括的な和平枠組みの要素について話し合われたことも明らかにした。

トランプ大統領の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏は２１日のプーチン氏との会談にオンライン形式で参加する。

item.title: Colts add WR Mecole Hardman Jr., P Thomas Morstead to practice squad
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts signed two veteran players, wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr. and punter Thomas Morstead, to their practice squad on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indianapolis Colts signed two veteran players, wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr. and punter Thomas Morstead, to their practice squad on Tuesday. The Colts also released rookie wide receiver Eli Pancol from the practice squad. He originally was signed to the practice squad on Nov. 18, 2025, and re-signed on Sept. 23. Hardman, 28, played in two games last season for the Buffalo Bills. He did not record a reception on his one target. He returned two punts for 4 yards and one kickoff for 61 yards. A Pro Bowl selection and second-team All-Pro (return specialist) as a rookie in 2019, Hardman has 178 career catches for 2,302 yards and 16 touchdowns, as well as 26 rushing attempts for 190 yards and three TDs in 82 regular-season games (28 starts) with the Kansas City Chiefs (2019-24), New York Jets (2023) and Bills (2025). He has returned 91 punts for 823 yards and one touchdown, and 46 kickoffs for 1,134 yards and one TD. Hardman won three Super Bowl titles with the Chiefs in the 2019, 2022 and 2023 seasons. Kansas City selected Hardman in the second round of the 2019 NFL Draft out of Georgia. Morstead, 40, played last season for the San Francisco 49ers and punted 44 times for a 43.6-yard average in 17 games. He has played for five teams and averaged 46.7 yards on 1,004 punts in 272 games over 17 seasons. Morstead was a Pro Bowl selection in 2012 with the New Orleans Saints. New Orleans selected Morstead in the fifth round of the 2009 draft out of SMU. The Saints won the Super Bowl that season. He played 12 seasons in New Orleans and then moved on to the Jets (2021, 2023-24), Atlanta Falcons (2021), Miami Dolphins (2022) and 49ers (2025). Pancol, 26, has not appeared in an NFL game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Thunder, Spurs open NBA season as co-favorites to win title
item.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs are co-favorites to win the title as they close out the opening day of the 2026-27 NBA regular season in San Antonio on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs are co-favorites to win the title as they close out the opening day of the 2026-27 NBA regular season in San Antonio on Tuesday night. BetMGM is offering the Western Conference rivals at +260 to win the title. The Spurs' odds have shifted slightly from opening at +270 to match the Thunder by opening day. The Philadelphia 76ers have the third-shortest odds at +850 with their star-studded cast that includes newcomers LeBron James and Jaylen Brown alongside returning stars Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey. Philadelphia opened as a +6000 long shot, but those odds shifted significantly following the trade for Brown and the free-agent signing of James. Going a bit in the opposite direction have been the reigning champion New York Knicks, who are now +1000 after opening at +700. "The Thunder and Spurs are clear favorites to win the NBA Championship, but bettors love the 76ers," BetMGM senior trader Anthony Parenti said. "Nearly 40% of all money wagered has been on Philly to win the title after trading for Jaylen Brown and signing LeBron James in the offseason. "The Sixers are the biggest liability to win the championship." The 76ers have attracted 29.2% of all title bets and 35.9% of the money wagered since the market opened. Despite the Los Angeles Lakers owning only +3500 odds to win the title, Luka Doncic leads the book with 14.1% of the total bets and 24.8% of the money backing him at +475 to win MVP. Dallas Mavericks second-year star Cooper Flagg is the book's biggest MVP liability at +20000. --Field Level Media

item.title: South Carolina opens at No. 1 in preseason Top 25 poll
item.description: South Carolina is atop the rankings at No. 1 in The Associated Press preseason Top 25 women's basketball poll released Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Carolina is atop the rankings at No. 1 in The Associated Press preseason Top 25 women's basketball poll released Tuesday. The Gamecocks received 23 of 31 first-place votes and 764 points from a national media panel. No. 2 UConn (746 points) earned six first-place votes and No. 3 Southern California (668) had two. Duke (647) and Michigan (644) rounded out the top five. South Carolina coach Dawn Staley's program is the preseason No. 1 for the fifth time in the past seven seasons. "It's a gift and curse," Staley told the AP. "I tend to not look at the number, but our players do. They look at it and feel like there's a sense of respect to being No. 1. "They also know that it's pressure-packed with the type of non-conference schedule we have, we're going to be challenged. If we stand there at No. 1 at the end of our nonconference season, that's something to truly be proud of." South Carolina (36-4 last season) was routed 79-51 by UCLA in last season's title game. UConn (38-1) also reached the Final Four before falling 62-48 to South Carolina. The Huskies have been ranked in the top 10 of every preseason AP poll since 1994. USC (18-14) has high hopes after getting star JuJu Watkins back. She sustained a serious knee injury in the 2025 NCAA Tournament and missed all of last season. After the top five, Texas checks in at No. 6, followed by Louisville, Vanderbilt, LSU and Iowa. Defending champion UCLA is No. 11. The Bruins set records for five first-round picks and six overall players selected from one school in the WNBA Draft. The Big Ten has a record nine teams in the preseason rankings. One of them is Minnesota, which opens at No. 17 but lost leading scorer Tori McKinney to a season-ending knee injury in practice last week. --Field Level Media AP Top 25 Preseason Women's Poll First-place votes in parentheses TEAM RECORD 1. item.title: 原油先物、5カ月ぶり高値から反落 イラン情勢・フーシ派攻撃など材料交錯
item.description:
Georgina McCartney
[ヒューストン ２０日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、取引時間中に５カ月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物、5カ月ぶり高値から反落　イラン情勢・フーシ派攻撃など材料交錯 5:43 配信

米テキサス州ミッドランド郊外で稼働する石油ポンプジャック。2025年6月撮影。REUTERS/Eli Hartman

Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン　２０日　ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、取引時間中に５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、反落して取引を終えた。イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が０．７６ドル（０．６９％）安の１バレル＝１０８．７９ドル。取引時間中に一時、期近物が１１１．９９ドルと、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。

米ＷＴＩ先物１１月限は１．８７ドル（１．８％）安の１０１．７９ドル。一時、１１０．４８ドルの高値を付け、期近物として４月以来の高水準となった。より取引が活発な１２月限は０．７２ドル安の９７．８２ドル。

ペゼシュキアン大統領は２０日、首都テヘランを訪問したムニール陸軍元帥と会談した。イランのヌールニュースによると、両氏は仲介の取り組みや地域情勢について協議した。

こうした中、フーシ派は１９日、サウジアラビアのエネルギー関連施設や空港、軍事施設を標的とした複数の攻撃を実施したと表明。サウジ西部の紅海沿岸都市ヤンブーにある国有石油企業サウジアラムコの施設、シャイバ油田、首都リヤドのキング・ハーリド国際空港、アブハ空港を攻撃したとした。

ＩＮＧのアナリストは２０日付のリポートで「原油価格は引き続き底堅く推移している。これは、情勢の不安定さを踏まえ、市場が大きなリスクプレミアムを織り込んでいることを示唆する」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：石油価格、イラン攻撃による急騰から持久戦へ コラム：ホルムズ封鎖で石油貿易に変化、米州が最大の受益者に アングル：世界の石油備蓄、イラン戦争長期化による大規模供給途絶を乗り切れるか 焦点：エジプト沖ドローン攻撃が脅かす原油輸送代替ルート、スエズ運河巡る安全性に懸念 アングル：原油価格、イラン紛争でも予想ほど急騰しなかった訳 最終更新: 10/21(水) 5:43 ロイター

item.title: Super Micro sees quarterly revenue soaring on AI server boom
item.description: Super Micro Computer expects quarterly revenue and profit margin well above Wall Street estimates as it benefits from relentless AI data center demand, the server maker said on Tuesday, sending shares 11.3% higher in after-hours trading.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Super Micro Computer (SMCI.O) expects quarterly revenue and profit margin well above Wall Street estimates as it benefits from relentless AI data center demand, the server maker said on Tuesday, sending shares 11.3% higher in after-hours trading. Rivals Dell (DELL.N) and HPE (HPE.N) gained between 3.5% and 4.9%. Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the AI chip giant, was up 1.5%. Big Tech's race to build out data centers has placed firms such as Super Micro among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom. Microsoft, Google, Amazon and Meta are expected to spend more than $700 billion on AI infrastructure this year. That is showing up in Super Micro's results. FORECAST FOLLOWS AI SELLOFF Shares of companies exposed to the AI data-center buildout fell last week after CoreWeave’s (CRWV.O) [USN:L4N46111C TEXT:"stock and bond slide"] and prospects of higher interest rates triggered concerns that heavily indebted operators could take longer than expected to generate returns. S&P Global said on Monday it [USN:L8N4651G6 TEXT:"estimates"] the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than known. Super Micro on Tuesday said it expects revenue between $18.5 billion and $19.5 billion in the first quarter, compared with analysts’ average estimate of $15.23 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. That expectation is also well above the company’s prior revenue forecast of $14.5 billion to $15.5 billion. The server maker also now expects gross margins to be in the range of 12% to 12.5% versus the prior expectation of 10.4% to 10.8%, and above analysts' estimate of 10.15%, primarily due to customer and product mix. Super Micro last week [USN:L4N4611AO TEXT:"appointed"] former Western Digital (WDC.O) executive Mark Long as its chief financial officer, nearly two years after beginning its search amid [USN:L4N3KE12G TEXT:"scrutiny"] of its financial and accounting practices.

item.title: スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収 テスラとの合併「良い案」とマスク氏
item.description:
Akash Sriram
[２０日 ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スペースＸ、第3四半期161％増収　テスラとの合併「良い案」とマスク氏 5:23 配信

６月１１日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Akash Sriram

[２０日　ロイター] - 米実業家イーロン・マスク氏は２０日、自身が率いる宇宙開発企業スペースＸと電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラの合併は「良い案だ」と述べ、両社が合併を協議する特別委員会を設置したことを明らかにした。スペースＸの株価は時間外取引で８％上昇した。

スペースＸはこれに先立ち、上場後初の黒字決算を発表。マスク氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームでデータセンター容量への需要が急増する中、２０２７年末までに年間経常収益が５０００億─１兆ドルに達するとの見通しを示した。

マスク氏は以前から、スペースＸとテスラの事業の重なりが拡大しているとして、合併の構想を示し、株主の関心を集めてきた。最近はスペースＸによるテスラ買収を巡る観測が強まっており、バークレイズは先週、１２月のテスラ年次株主総会前に合意が発表される可能性があるとの見方を示した。

マスク氏は投資家向け電話会議で「良い考えだと思うが、実際には両社の特別委員会次第だ」と述べ、正式に協議していることを初めて公式に認めた。「私は利益相反のある当事者なので、特別委員会の協議には実際には参加できない」と説明。最終的には株主の承認が必要になると述べた。

さらに「われわれは超知能によるシンギュラリティー（技術的特異点）にほぼ到達しており、両社の統合には大きな利点があると思う」とし、超知能ソフトウエアの開発、半導体設計、半導体合弁事業テラファブ、ロボット工学、スターマインド衛星群の構築に向けた軌道への輸送能力、通信接続の分野で協力することで、多くを得られると語った。

テラファブについては、２７年５─６月ごろに最初の試作半導体を製造する見通しで、２８年第３・四半期までの量産開始を目指すと述べた。

一方、特別委員会は取引条件で合意しておらず、今後も合意に至らない可能性があるとして、合併が実現すると考えるのは時期尚早だと指摘した。テスラ株は時間外取引で１．８％上昇した。

この日発表したスペースＸの第３・四半期決算は、売上高が前年同期比１６１％増の１４５億８０００万ドルとなり、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想の１２７億２０００万ドルを上回った。ＡＩ事業の売上高は約１０倍の７５億６０００万ドルに拡大した。その大半は独自のＡＩモデルではなく、アンソロピック、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、リフレクションＡＩといった開発企業へのデータセンター処理能力の貸し出しで稼いだ。

マスク氏は電話会議で「スペースＸは打ち上げ、通信、超知能の各分野で転換点を迎えている」と述べた。用意した説明の締めくくりに、原稿になかったとみられる発言として「要するに、これが意味するのは、２７年末までにスペースＸの年間経常収益が５０００億─１兆ドルになるということだ」と語った。

第３・四半期決算は、ＡＩ分野へのスペースＸの巨額投資が売り上げに結びついていることを、これまでで最も明確に示した。一方、計算処理インフラへの支出は依然として膨大で、設備投資額は約３倍の１９６億ドルに膨らんだ。

＜ＡＩ売上高が急拡大＞

スペースＸのブレット・ジョンセン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、２６年末までに年間経常収益が約１０００億ドルに達するとの見通しを改めて示した。

同氏は、第４・四半期の設備投資額を３５０億─４００億ドルと見込んでいると述べた。第３・四半期の設備投資額１９６億ドルのうち、ＡＩ事業が１６４億ドルを占めた。

資産運用会社グラナイトシェアーズのウィル・リンド最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「スペースＸは、少なくとも売上高では強気派が望んだ四半期決算を示した」と指摘。「今や焦点は全てＡＩだ。２６年に入って締結された計算処理能力の提供契約が、多くの人が考えていたより速く売り上げにつながっている」と述べた。

スペースＸのＡＩ事業は「Ｇｒｏｋ（グロック）」、交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）のＸ、急成長するデータセンター事業で構成される。

ＡＩ部門はこれまで多額の営業赤字を計上しており、スペースＸは安定的に利益を生み出せるようになるまで継続的な投資が必要になると注意を促していた。ただ、第３・四半期は前年同期の赤字から黒字に転換した。

テクノロジー調査会社フューチャラム・グループのダニエル・ニューマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「ＡＩが売上高で同社最大の事業となる中、ハイパースケール事業が急速に営業面での強さとレバレッジを提供しており、衛星・打ち上げ事業の進展にもつながるだろう。スペースＸの事業基盤の強化と多角化が進むにつれ、テスラとの合併が間近に迫っているように感じられる」と述べた。

第３・四半期の純損益は４４億ドルの黒字となり、前年同期の１１億ドルの赤字から黒字に転換。市場予想の１５億７０００万ドルの黒字も上回った。ＩＢＥＳの計算による調整後１株利益は０．４５ドルで、予想平均の０．１３ドルを上回った。

＜スターリンク加入者数が予想上回る＞

衛星インターネット部門は、追加の衛星打ち上げや、個人、企業、航空、海運、政府向けサービスの拡充を背景に、加入者基盤の拡大を続けている。

スターリンクの第３・四半期の加入者数は１３６０万人と、アナリスト予想の１２１９万人を上回った。ただ、成長には代償も伴っている。海外で低価格プランを展開する中、加入者１人当たりの月間平均売上高は２３年の９９ドルから第３・四半期には６９ドルに低下した。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＮＡＳＡローマン宇宙望遠鏡打ち上げへ、ダークエネルギーやダークマターの解明期待 アングル：米金融大手、第2四半期は軒並み好決算　投資銀・取引部門がけん引 アングル：スペースＸ株が公開価格割れ、投資家の信頼守れるか　他案件に影響も アングル：米国で新たに44万人の「ＡＩ長者」、高級品の支出と嗜好にも変化 焦点：ラッセル指数銘柄入れ替えで26日は米株取引急増か、スペースＸなど注目 最終更新: 10/21(水) 9:53 ロイター

item.title: 米ネトフリ、第4四半期利益見通しが市場予想下回る 時間外で株価5％超安
item.description:
Lisa Richwine
[ロサンゼルス ２０日 ロイター] - 米動画配信サービス大手ネットフリックスが２０日公表...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ネトフリ、第4四半期利益見通しが市場予想下回る　時間外で株価5％超安 5:19 配信

米ネットフリックスのロゴ。2024年2月、インド・ムンバイで開催されたイベントで撮影。REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

Lisa Richwine

[ロサンゼルス　２０日　ロイター] - 米動画配信サービス大手ネットフリックスが２０日公表した第４・四半期（１０─１２月）の利益見通しは市場予想を下回った。２０２６年通期の広告収入見通しも引き下げた。

株価は時間外取引で６％近く下落し、６４．６６ドルとなった。この１年では４０％超下げている。

テッド・サランドス共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は決算発表後のビデオ会議で、ネットフリックスを欠かせないサービスにするため、質の高いテレビ番組や映画を制作する中核事業に注力する方針だと説明。最近の幹部人事刷新は、その目標に向けた一歩だとし、「われわれには改善の余地があると認識している。今、作品のラインアップを一段と充実させる機会が見えてきた」と語った。

第４・四半期の純利益見通しは２７億９０００万ドル、１株当たり利益（ＥＰＳ）見通しは０．６７ドルと、アナリスト予想平均の３０億７０００万ドル、０．７３ドルをそれぞれ下回った。

併せて発表した第３・四半期の売上高は１１．８％増の１２８億７０００万ドルと市場予想と一致したものの、伸び率は約３年ぶりの低水準となった。一方、１株利益は０．８７ドルと、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の０．８２ドルを上回った。

２６年の広告収入見通しは約３０億ドルから約２７億ドルに引き下げた。経営陣は四半期の株主向け書簡で、広告商品の一部機能の導入が想定よりやや遅れたと説明した。

約２０年前にテレビ番組や映画の配信を始め、ハリウッドに変革をもたらした同社は現在、視聴が急増するユーチューブやＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）との競争に直面。こうした中、新たな視聴者を獲得し、会員の利用時間を伸ばすため、ビデオゲームやポッドキャスト、ライブイベントに投資してきた。

ウォール街のアナリストからは、同社がどのように成長を再加速させるのか疑問の声が上がっている。

ＰＰフォーサイトのアナリスト、パオロ・ペスカトーレ氏は「ネットフリックスは引き続き効率的に運営され、高い収益力を持つ企業だが、本来不要な取り組みに手を広げすぎている」と指摘。「基本に立ち返り、魅力的なコンテンツに注力する必要がある」と述べた。

ネットフリックスは決算発表で、外部コンテンツのライセンス取得を増やし、配信作品を引き続き拡充する方針を示した。その上で、経営陣は株主向け書簡で、テレビ番組、映画、ライブイベントの配信という中核サービスに注力し、「話題を呼び、会員を増やし、われわれを『欠かせない』サービスにする」オリジナル番組に投資すると説明した。

同社は先週、全従業員の６％に相当する約１０００人を削減すると発表した。また、チーフクリエーティブオフィサー（ＣＣＯ）のベラ・バジャリア氏を交代させ、映画部門責任者のダン・リン氏も退任すると明らかにし、番組編成戦略を立て直す姿勢を示した。

ネットフリックスは今年、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリーの買収競争に敗れた。一部のアナリストは、ネットフリックスが他の買収対象に目を向ける可能性があるとみており、コムキャストが分離した後のＮＢＣユニバーサルなどを候補に挙げている。

調査会社アンテナのデータによると、ネットフリックスの米国契約者数は２６年に入り９月まで毎月純減となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か アングル：ネットフリックス、ワーナー買収失敗でオリジナル作品に注力 コラム：ユーチューブは敵か味方か、放送業界の新たな覇権巡る攻防 最終更新: 10/21(水) 8:40 ロイター

item.title: Dow se destaca em Wall Street, com ações do setor de saúde liderando os ganhos
item.description: O Dow subiu 1% nesta terça-feira, superando o índice de referência S&P 500, enquanto o setor de saúde foi o que mais impulsionou Wall Street e o de tecnologia foi o que mais prejudicou o mercado.
item.dc:creator: Sinead Carew, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: O Dow subiu 1% nesta terça-feira, superando o índice de referência S&P 500, enquanto o setor de saúde foi o que mais impulsionou Wall Street e o de tecnologia foi o que mais prejudicou o mercado. O setor de saúde (.SPXHC) liderou os ganhos entre os 11 principais índices setoriais do S&P 500, atingindo uma máxima recorde. A Eli Lilly (LLY.N) foi a empresa que mais contribuiu para o índice S&P 500, enquanto a UnitedHealth (UNH.N) , a MSD & Co (MRK.N) , a Johnson & Johnson (JNJ.N) e a Amgen (AMGN.O) ajudaram a impulsionar o índice Dow Jones de blue chips. As quedas nas ações de megacapitalização puxaram para baixo o setor de serviços de comunicação (.SPLRCL) , enquanto as ações do setor de energia (.SPNY) tiveram desempenho inferior, já que os preços do petróleo caíram após atingirem o maior nível em cinco meses. Os operadores do mercado de petróleo avaliavam uma reunião entre o presidente iraniano e o chefe do Exército do Paquistão — um importante mediador entre os EUA e o Irã —, em contraste com os ataques houthis à infraestrutura saudita e relatos de ataques a embarcações no Golfo. AÇÕES DO SETOR DE TECNOLOGIA DÃO UMA PAUSA Embora o setor de tecnologia de grande peso (.SPLRCT) tenha recuado 0,3%, esse foi o maior fator de queda em pontos do índice S&P 500 e manteve o Nasdaq praticamente estável. As ações de tecnologia haviam se recuperado na segunda-feira após uma onda de vendas na semana passada, quando os investidores se preocuparam com os altos custos de gastos e financiamento para desenvolvimentos em IA. “Os investidores em ações ainda estão um pouco céticos em relação ao setor de IA e à capacidade de algumas dessas empresas de monetizar seus investimentos, então estamos vendo uma certa rotação para outras áreas do mercado”, disse Jim Baird, diretor de investimentos da Plante Moran Financial Advisors, apontando para os avanços registrados nesta terça-feira nas empresas de pequena capitalização e do setor de saúde. “Os investidores estão buscando outras oportunidades fora do setor de tecnologia, e o setor de saúde é um dos beneficiários disso”, disse ele. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 1,02%, para 52.495,88 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançou 0,28%, para 7.712,57 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) teve variação negativa de 0,02%, para 26.424,82 pontos. O índice de valor do S&P 500 (.IVX) subiu 0,9%, em comparação com uma queda de 0,2% em seu equivalente de crescimento (.IGX) . O índice Russell 2000 de pequenas capitalizações (.RUT) fechou com alta de 1,7%. Com um ganho de 1%, o setor de serviços financeiros (.SPSY) foi o segundo maior impulsionador do índice S&P 500. Os setores defensivos também tiveram desempenho superior, com o setor imobiliário (.SPLRCR) subindo 1,7% e o de serviços públicos (.SPLRCU) registrando alta de 1,2%. Uma queda de 1,7% na Netflix, um recuo de 1,6% na Meta (META.O) e uma perda de 1% na Alphabet, controladora do Google (GOOGL.O) , fizeram com que o índice de serviços de comunicação caísse 0,9%. A SpaceX (SPCX.O) divulgou, após o fechamento do mercado, um lucro no terceiro trimestre que superou as estimativas, impulsionando suas ações em 4% no pós-mercado. A Netflix (NFLX.O) divulgou, após o fechamento do mercado, uma previsão de lucro para o quarto trimestre abaixo do esperado, e suas ações caíam 6%. A Meta e a Tesla (TSLA.O) devem divulgar seus resultados na quarta-feira. As ações da General Motors (GM.N) tombaram 6,8% depois que a montadora sinalizou pressão nos próximos meses devido ao aumento dos custos das matérias-primas e à queda nas vendas de caminhões. A 3M (MMM.N) ssubiu 5,8% depois que a empresa anunciou que estava ampliando sua parceria de data centers com a Amazon (AMZN.O) e emitiu um warrant a uma subsidiária da Amazon para a compra de ações ordinárias da 3M no valor de mais de US$521 milhões. O conglomerado industrial também elevou sua previsão de lucro para o ano inteiro. A empresa de relatórios de crédito Equifax (EFX.N) disparou 11,3% após divulgar lucro no terceiro trimestre acima das estimativas dos analistas. As ações da Hasbro (HAS.O) saltaram 11,2% depois que a fabricante de brinquedos elevou sua previsão para o ano inteiro tanto para a receita geral quanto para seu negócio de jogos digitais.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝ダウ主導で上昇、ヘルスケア株に買い ナスダック横ばい
item.description:
Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
［ニューヨーク ２０日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ダウ主導で上昇、ヘルスケア株に買い　ナスダック横ばい 5:12 配信

2026年6月23日、米国カリフォルニア州サンディエゴで撮影　REUTERS/Mike Blake

Tharuniyaa Lakshmi

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はダウ工業株３０種が１％上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種を上回る値上がりとなった。ヘルスケア株が相場を最も押し上げた一方、前日に反発したハイテク株は軟調だった。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の主要１１業種では、ヘルスケア株指数が上昇率首位となり、過去最高値を更新した。イーライリリーがＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種への押し上げ寄与度で首位となった。ユナイテッドヘルス、メルク、ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソン（Ｊ＆Ｊ）、アムジェンはダウの上昇に寄与した。

超大型株の下落で通信サービス指数は値下がりした。原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後に下落したことを受け、エネルギー指数もさえない値動きとなった。原油市場では、イランのペゼシュキアン大統領とパキスタン軍トップのムニール陸軍元帥のテヘランでの会談や、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派のサウジアラビアのインフラに対する攻撃継続、湾岸での船舶攻撃の報道など材料が交錯した。

情報技術指数の下落率は０．３％にとどまったが、構成比率が大きいため、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種への最大の圧迫要因となり、ナスダック総合もほぼ横ばいに抑えられた。ハイテク株は先週、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発を巡る巨額の支出や資金調達コストへの懸念から売られたが、１９日には反発していた。

プラント・モラン・ファイナンシャル・アドバイザーズのジム・ベアード最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は、この日の小型株やヘルスケアなどの上昇に言及し、「株式投資家はＡＩ関連投資や、一部企業が投資を収益化できるかどうかについて、依然としてやや懐疑的だ。そのため、市場の他の分野に資金が移る動きが見られる」と指摘。「投資家はハイテク以外の投資機会を探しており、ヘルスケアはその恩恵を受ける分野の一つだ」と語った。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００バリュー指数は０．９％上昇した一方、グロース指数は０．２％下落した。小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は１．７％高で取引を終えた。

金融指数は１％上昇。ディフェンシブ業種も堅調で、不動産は１．７％、公益事業は１．２％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは１．７％、メタ・プラットフォームズは１．６％、グーグルの親会社アルファベットは１％それぞれ下落し、通信サービス指数は０．９％安となった。

スペースＸは取引終了後に発表した第３・四半期利益が市場予想を大幅に上回り、時間外取引で株価が４％上昇した。

ネットフリックスは取引終了後に発表した第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を下回り、株価は６％下落した。

メタとテスラは２１日に決算発表を予定している。

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は６．８％急落。コモディティー（商品）価格の上昇とトラック販売の減少が今後数カ月の業績を圧迫するとの見通しを示した。

複合企業のスリーエム（３Ｍ）は５．８％上昇した。アマゾン・ドット・コムとのデータセンター事業での提携拡大を発表し、アマゾン子会社に対し、５億２１００万ドル超相当の３Ｍ普通株を購入できる新株予約権を発行した。通期利益見通しも引き上げた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では、値上がり銘柄数と値下がり銘柄数の比率が２．０４対１だった。ナスダックでも２．０２対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５９億１０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億５０００万株。

item.title: United Airlines profit outlook well below estimates, hit by fuel costs
item.description: United Airlines on Tuesday forecast fourth-quarter profit well below Wall Street estimates despite expectations for record revenue, as soaring fuel costs were expected to persist, eating into gains from strong travel demand and higher ticket prices.
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Singh
item.content:encoded: United Airlines (UAL.O) on Tuesday forecast fourth-quarter profit well below Wall Street estimates despite expectations for record revenue, as soaring fuel costs were expected to persist, eating into gains from strong travel demand and higher ticket prices. Airline fares are rising sharply, but fuel costs are climbing even faster, squeezing profits industry wide. With the Iran war threatening to keep fuel prices elevated into 2027, analysts say carriers may have to raise fares further and risk losing customers, or limit flight growth to support ticket prices and protect profits. Earlier this month, United's [USN:L4N45U1TW TEXT:"rival Delta Air Lines"] (DAL.N) cut its annual earnings forecast by nearly a quarter after projecting a $6 billion increase in its fuel bill from last year. Delta CEO Ed Bastian warned that airlines may need to further restrain flight growth next year to sustain higher fares and protect profitability. United expects to pay $4.80 a gallon for jet fuel in the fourth quarter, about 45 cents more than the market consensus assumption. The difference translates into roughly $1 per share in earnings, the company said. The Chicago-based carrier expects adjusted earnings of 50 cents to $1.50 per share for the December quarter. LSEG data shows an average analyst estimate of $1.76. The $1 midpoint of the carrier's outlook is 43% below expectations. Alaska Air Group (ALK.N) added to the industry's warnings on Tuesday, forecasting a fourth-quarter adjusted loss of $2 to $2.50 per share, compared with analyst expectations for a $1.04 loss. The carrier expects its fuel bill for the year to run $1.8 billion above its original plan. Alaska's third-quarter revenue rose 14%, yet its adjusted pretax margin narrowed to 1.1% from 4.6% a year earlier. It expects revenue per unit of capacity to grow by a low-double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter, despite projecting a substantial loss. HIGHER FARES, THINNER MARGINS United's third-quarter results show how soaring fuel costs are eating into gains from higher fares. Its additional fuel spending was equivalent to nearly 70% of the increase in quarterly revenue. Despite record sales, adjusted pretax profit fell and its margin narrowed to 6.2% from 8% a year earlier. Demand, however, remains strong. United carried a record number of passengers, with revenue from business travelers, premium cabins and basic economy all growing at double-digit rates. The airline generated significantly more revenue without substantially increasing flying capacity. The squeeze extends across the industry. US air fares rose an average of nearly 23% year-on-year in the seven months through September, according to Labor Department data. The industry's fuel bill, however, has been climbing even faster. US airlines spent $42.9 billion on fuel in the first eight months of 2026, up $13.2 billion from a year earlier despite slightly lower consumption, government data showed. Analysts at Deutsche Bank have warned that further fare increases could weaken demand, forcing airlines to slow flight growth to support ticket prices. The pressure is spreading beyond the United States. Ryanair (RYA.I) CEO Michael O'Leary [USN:L6N4660EL TEXT:"warned"] on Tuesday that European airfares could rise as much as 20% next year as higher fuel costs and reduced airline capacity squeeze the industry. United and Alaska Air will discuss their financial results in separate calls with analysts and investors on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger is 'a good idea' as companies form deal committees
item.description: He has in the past tantalized shareholders with the idea of combining the two, citing growing overlap between them.
item.dc:creator: Akash Sriram, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk said on Tuesday that a merger of his two companies SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) would be "a good idea" and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union, sending shares of the space and technology company up 8% in extended trading. The company earlier posted its first profit as a public company and Musk said he expected annual recurring revenue of between $500 billion and $1 trillion by the end of 2027, as demand for its data-center space surges thanks to the AI boom. Musk has in the past tantalized shareholders with the idea of combining SpaceX and Tesla, [USN:L6N43O1D8 TEXT:"citing growing overlap"] between them. Speculation about the space company buying the EV maker has [USN:L6N46612X TEXT:"gained traction"] recently, with Barclays suggesting last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting in December. "I think it would be a good idea, but it's really up to the special committees of both companies," Musk said in the first official confirmation that the companies were formally talking. "Because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussions of the special committees," which comprised independent directors, he told investors on a conference call. The companies had formed the special committees at the request of shareholders, who ultimately would need to approve a deal, he added. "I do think there's a lot of merit to combining the companies as we are pretty much in the superintelligence singularity, and there's a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing superintelligence software, chip design, the Terafab obviously, robotics, mass-to-orbit with the Starmind constellation, connectivity," he said. Terafab, the chip manufacturing joint venture between the two companies, should produce its [USN:L6N4661EP TEXT:"first test chip"] around May or June of next year and aims to reach volume production by the third quarter of 2028, Musk said on the call. Musk added that it would be premature to assume a SpaceX-Tesla merger would happen, noting that the special committees had not agreed on transaction terms and may never do so. Tesla shares rose 1.8% in extended trading. The world's richest person, Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and just under half of SpaceX, and analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity. The talks started in recent weeks and could result in SpaceX acquiring Tesla, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters, who declined to be named because they were not authorized to talk to media. Tesla has been working with an investment bank to advise on the discussions, the person said. AI REVENUE DRIVES SPACEX TRANSFORMATION SpaceX's revenue climbed 161% to $14.58 billion for the three months ended September 30 from a year earlier. AI revenue surged by almost 10 times to $7.56 billion, mostly from renting out data-center capacity to developers such as Anthropic, Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google and Reflection AI rather than from its own models. The third quarter offered the clearest evidence yet that SpaceX’s heavy investment in AI is translating into revenue, even as spending on compute infrastructure remains enormous — capital expenses nearly tripled to $19.6 billion. The shift is reshaping a company whose financial engine has long been its Starlink internet services business and whose longer-term ambitions still hinge on getting Starship rockets into regular service. For now, though, its main business looks closer to a cloud provider's than an AI lab's. SpaceX's chief financial officer, Bret Johnsen, said the company expects $35 billion to $40 billion in capital expenditure in the fourth quarter. "SpaceX delivered the quarter the bulls wanted, at least on the top line," said Will Rhind, CEO of asset manager GraniteShares. "The story now is all about AI. The compute contracts signed earlier this year are turning into revenue faster than a lot of people thought." The company's AI business spans Grok, social media platform X and a fast-growing data-center operation. The business also turned a profit in the third quarter, compared with a year-ago loss. SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion versus a net loss of $1.1 billion a year earlier and analysts' expectation for a profit of $1.57 billion. On a per-share, adjusted basis, it earned 45 cents according to IBES calculations, outstripping a 13-cent average estimate. STARLINK SUBSCRIBERS TOP FORECASTS The satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its subscriber base, aided by additional satellite launches and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services. Starlink reached 13.6 million subscribers in the third quarter, above the 12.19 million analysts expected, but growth is coming at a price: average monthly revenue per subscriber has fallen from $99 in 2023 to $69 in the third quarter as it expands abroad with cheaper plans. The company has said geographic expansion beyond the wealthiest countries could push average revenue per user lower over time. Starship, SpaceX's next-generation reusable rocket system, has yet to enter commercial service. It is expected to enable deployment of higher-bandwidth Starlink satellites and orbital AI-computing infrastructure. The company's ability to turn Starship into a reliably reusable vehicle is central to its longer-term strategy. The space segment includes commercial launches, government missions and Starship development and remains a significant source of costs and uncertainty.

item.title: US FDA approves GSK's hepatitis B drug, offering patients chance to stop long-term treatment
item.description: The US FDA said on Tuesday it had approved British drugmaker GSK's hepatitis B drug Hibsago, allowing patients with the liver infection a way to keep the virus under control after stopping treatment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA said on Tuesday it had approved British drugmaker GSK's (GSK.L) hepatitis B drug Hibsago, allowing patients with the liver infection a way to keep the virus under control after stopping treatment. The drug, chemically known as bepirovirsen, is the first FDA-approved antisense oligonucleotide for chronic hepatitis B, according to the agency. Under new CEO Luke Miels, GSK is aiming to speed up the develop and launch of new medicines ahead of looming patent expirations on its blockbuster HIV drugs. The company expects [USN:L4N4241LO TEXT:"peak annual sales"] of more than £2 billion ($2.68 billion) for the drug and is central to its plans to reach more than £40 billion in annual revenue by 2031. Hibsago has already secured approval in Japan and is under regulatory review in China and Europe. The drug was licensed from rare disease drugmaker Ionis Pharmaceuticals (IONS.O) , which is eligible to receive milestone payments upon approval and other regulatory benchmarks. In clinical trials, bepirovirsen helped nearly one-in-five patients achieve undetectable levels of the hepatitis B virus and remain off antiviral treatment for at least six months. Hepatitis B is a serious liver infection that can lead to liver damage and cirrhosis, or scarring of the liver. The virus spreads through infected bodily fluids such as blood, saliva and semen. More than 250 million people globally live with chronic hepatitis B, and current standard-of-care treatments help only 1% to 4% of patients clear the virus for a sustained period, or achieve what doctors call a functional cure. Nucleotide analogues, a widely used class of hepatitis B treatments, are often taken for life and suppress the virus but rarely eliminate it. US biotech Aligos Therapeutics (ALGS.O) is developing a rival hepatitis B therapy, pevifoscorvir sodium, which is being evaluated in a mid-stage trial. GSK did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on US pricing and commercial availability. ($1 = 0.7474 pounds)

item.title: Netflix co-CEO Sarandos says 'we could do better' after weak forecast
item.description: Days earlier the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Richwine, Jaspreet Singh
item.content:encoded: Netflix (NFLX.O) issued weaker-than-expected guidance for fourth-quarter profit and cut its full-year advertising forecast on Tuesday, days after the streaming pioneer laid off 6% of its workforce and replaced two of its top programming executives. Shares of Netflix fell nearly 6% to $64.66 in after-hours trading. The stock had fallen more than 40% in a year before the earnings report. Co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the company plans to focus on its core business of producing quality TV shows and movies to make Netflix a must-have service, and the recent executive shakeup was a step toward that goal. "I know that we could do better," Sarandos said in a post-earnings video call. "Now we've seen an opportunity to take our slate to the next level." Third-quarter revenue rose 11.8% to $12.87 billion, in line with Wall Street forecasts, but the lowest rate of increase in nearly three years. The company forecast fourth-quarter net income of $2.79 billion and EPS of 67 cents, below the average analyst forecast of $3.07 billion and 73 cents. Netflix reduced its advertising forecast for 2026 to roughly $2.7 billion, down from about $3 billion. Some ad product capabilities rolled out slightly slower than expected, executives said in their quarterly letter to shareholders. The company that shook up Hollywood when it started streaming TV shows and movies two decades ago is now competing with a surge in viewership on YouTube and TikTok. Netflix has invested in video games, podcasts and live events to draw new viewers and increase the time members spend on the platform. Wall Street analysts have questioned how the company will kick-start growth. "Netflix remains a well-oiled, highly profitable machine, but focused on too many unwanted distractions," PP Foresight analyst Paolo Pescatore said. "The company needs to get back to basics and focus on compelling content." In its earnings report, Netflix said it would continue to expand its offerings through licensing more third-party content. For the third quarter, earnings per share came in at 87 cents, ahead of the 82-cent average forecast of analysts surveyed by LSEG. New programming during the quarter included "Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story," the second season of "The Gentlemen," the final installment of "Outer Banks" and a reboot of "Little House on the Prairie." Last week, Netflix [USN:L6N4600X7 TEXT:"laid off 1,000 people"], or about 6% of its employees. The company replaced Chief Creative Officer Bela [USN:L4N46128P TEXT:"Bajaria"] and said film chief [USN:L4N4651E5 TEXT:"Dan Lin was departing"], signs that it is resetting its programming strategy. The company named former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice to replace Bajaria. He also will oversee the film division until a replacement for Lin is chosen. "Peter Rice understands talent relations, and in a competitive market, creative talent have choices of where they want to work," Sarandos said on Tuesday. "We want Netflix to always be the place that they love to do the best work of their life." Earlier this year, Netflix lost a bidding war for Warner Bros Discovery and its rich library of characters, which was sold to David Ellison-led Skydance . Some analysts believe Netflix could go after other acquisition targets such as NBCUniversal after Comcast (CMCSA.O) spins it off. Netflix has posted monthly subscriber losses in the US throughout 2026, with no net additions reported for any month up to September, data from analytics firm Antenna showed. Antenna tracks US subscription purchases via sources like credit card transactions, but excludes subscriptions acquired through wholesale bundles. A Netflix spokesperson said the Antenna data were "not representative of Netflix's business performance." Sarandos said there was no need for a "fundamental shift" in strategy but added: "We do need better execution in the US."

item.title: トランプ氏 、加ボンバルディア排除の脅し撤回 カンザス州の雇用「守る」
item.description:
David Shepardson Allison Lampert
[ワシントン／モントリオール ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Shepardson　Allison Lampert

[ワシントン／モントリオール ２０日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、カナダの航空機メーカーであるボンバルディアを米市場から締め出すとの脅しを撤回し、代わりにカンザス州の同社従業員を「しっかり守る」と約束した。

トランプ氏が９月にボンバルディアの米市場での販売禁止を示唆したことは、ウィチタで１５００人を雇用するカンザス州で政治問題化していた。販売禁止の脅しを受け、共和党のロジャー・マーシャル上院議員らカンザス州選出の議員は、ホワイトハウスに働きかけを行った。

トランプ氏はカンザス州の「１２ニュース」に対し、マーシャル氏の関与に言及しつつ、「ボンバルディアを守る」と述べた。その上で「ある航空会社の立て直しを手伝うつもりだ。私はずっと彼らをカナダ企業と見なしてきた」と説明。「しかし今、同社が米国内に拠点を置いていることが分かった。カンザス州にいるのなら彼らを傷つけるつもりはない。従業員と雇用を守るつもりだ」と述べた。

トランプ氏の発言を受け、ボンバルディアの株価は一時、４％上昇した。

ホワイトハウスはコメントを控え、質問についてはトランプ氏のテレビインタビューを参照するよう求めた。

item.title: League says Eagles handled Hurts medical condition appropriately
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles handled Jalen Hurts' medical condition appropriately, an NFL spokesperson told Reuters on Tuesday, after the quarterback was sidelined indefinitely due to blood clots in his lungs.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Eagles handled Jalen Hurts' medical condition appropriately, an NFL spokesperson told Reuters on Tuesday, after the quarterback was sidelined indefinitely due to blood clots in his lungs. Hurts was diagnosed with a left calf superficial vein thrombosis prior to playing in an October 11 contest against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London. After further testing and monitoring, he was diagnosed with deep vein thrombosis and a bilateral pulmonary embolism, [USN:L6N4650YZ TEXT:"the team said"] on Monday. The NFL had stayed in close contact with the team, the spokesperson said, and found that the Eagles had handled the matter appropriately, after a day of outcry from many pundits and fans, who questioned why Hurts was allowed to play at all in the London game. The 2025 Super Bowl MVP is clinically stable as he undergoes treatment with blood thinners, but he is expected to be out for the season. A bilateral pulmonary embolism is a dangerous condition in which a blood clot blocks an artery in both lungs. The NFL was in contact with Eagles medical personnel and the Cleveland Clinic in London, where Hurts was tested. The league's chief medical officer arranges medical resources in every international market with approval from the players' union, the spokesperson added. NFL owners gathered in New York on Tuesday for their fall meeting amid an ambitious international slate of games this season, with a record nine contests abroad. League officials were critical of early media reports and speculation surrounding Hurts' condition, telling reporters at a press conference on Tuesday that doctors caring for players are not ever influenced by coaches, general managers or team owners. "If you're not sitting in that room with that patient and you don't have all the data, if you are speculating as a physician on what should have been done, you are unprofessional and unethical in doing that," said NFL Chief Medical Officer Allen Sills. Sills said there was no set league protocol for blood clots, as there is with concussions. "I have complete confidence in the Eagles staff and their handling of this situation," he added. "I would characterize their work as very conservative, very patient, focused and appropriately guarded at every step."

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ懸念が重し 円は20年債入札好調で上昇
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２０日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、ＡＩ懸念が重し　円は20年債入札好調で上昇 4:48 配信

３月２４日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

［ニューヨーク　２０日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対し下落した。ドルは原油価格と米長期債利回りの低下に歩調を合わせるように下落。市場では、米国とイランの対立激化による影響のほか、米国のＡＩ（人工知能）関連企業に対する旺盛な資本流入が持続可能性が注目されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．２１％高の１５８．１４円。日本の財務省が実施した２０年利付国債入札で応札倍率が５．８４倍と、前回（４．０１倍）から大幅に上昇し、同入札としては過去最高を付けたことが円の支援材料になった。

ステート・ストリート・インベストメント・マネジメントのシニア債券ストラテジスト、マサヒコ・ルー氏は「２０年債入札に対する記録的な需要は、待機資金がついに市場に戻り始めたことを示す強いシグナルになる」と指摘。「フランスの政治・財政面での不透明感を背景に、資金の安全な逃避先として日本国債の魅力が相対的に高まりつつある」と述べた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％安１０１．７１。ユーロは対ドルで０．２２％高の１．１２３５ドル。

この日は原油価格が一時５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、下落。ただ、市場ではＡＩを巡る懸念がより大きく意識されている。野村証券のＧ１０通貨戦略責任者、ドミニク・バニング氏は、「エネルギー価格の上昇はドル相場にとって追い風になるが、金利がＡＩ関連取引を崩壊させるほど高い水準に達すれば、ドル相場にとってマイナスの影響を及ぼすことになる」と指摘。「現在はまさにその境目となる水準が試されているところだ」としている。

ユーロはこの日の取引では対ドルで上昇したものの、市場ではフランスの財政状況の悪化や各地で広がる抗議活動への警戒感から、ユーロに対する慎重な見方が根強い。スウェーデンのハンデルスバンケンの外国為替ストラテジスト、トミー・フォンブロムセン氏は「フランスを巡る懸念はすぐには解消されない」と指摘。「フランスに対する弱気な見方は当面続くと見られるため、ユーロには一段の下落余地がある」と述べた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．３４％高の１．４０６カナダドルと、約１カ月ぶりの高水準を付けた。 カナダ西部アルバータ州で１９日に実施された分離独立を問う住民投票でカナダへの残留が支持され、国内の結束を図るカーニー首相にとって待望の勝利となった。

item.title: Anthropic logged net loss of over $80 billion in first half of 2026, WSJ reports
item.description: Anthropic reported a net loss of more than $80 billion in the first half of the year and signaled it could spend as much as $750 billion in the coming years to secure more computing capacity, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Anthropic reported a net loss of more than $80 billion in the first half of the year and signaled it could spend as much as $750 billion in the coming years to secure more computing capacity, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday. The loss, up from $13 billion a year earlier, was driven by $72 billion in accounting charges tied to changes in the value of financial instruments Anthropic issued to raise money, the report said, citing a draft prospectus for its IPO. The figures show the hefty costs of the AI race even as investors look harder at whether the money companies are pouring into chips and data centers will pay off. Anthropic's revenue jumped to $16.3 billion in the six months ended June 30 from $1.1 billion a year ago, while AI infrastructure spending nearly quadrupled to almost $9 billion, the Journal said. Anthropic did not respond to a request for comment and Reuters could not immediately verify the report. ANTHROPIC'S IPO VALUATION UNDER SCRUTINY Reuters reported first in September that Anthropic posted a net loss of [USN:L4N4500J8 TEXT:"$42 billion in 2025"], as part of a series of exclusives from its IPO prospectus. The company has benefited from the popularity of Claude Code, its coding assistant that developers use to write software and build apps. But some current investors and prospective investors who attended Anthropic's investor day last week are weighing a lower valuation for the AI company after its latest financial disclosures, four people familiar with the matter [USN:L6N4611F6 TEXT:"had told Reuters"]. The investors who attended the event in San Francisco discussed a valuation of around $1.5 trillion, three of the people had said, a significant step down from the roughly $2 trillion valuation previously expected for the November share sale. Anthropic told investors at the meeting that its third-quarter revenue jumped 45% to $16.8 billion from the previous quarter, and that it was profitable on an adjusted basis during the quarter. A cooler reception for Anthropic's IPO could weigh on the wider AI market, whose near-term prospects investors see as hinging largely on the share sale's success, ahead of rival OpenAI's potential listing next year.

item.title: FAA certifies Boeing's 737 MAX 10, clearing way for deliveries
item.description: The US Federal Aviation Administration on Tuesday granted final approval to the long-delayed Boeing 737 MAX 10, clearing the way for the US planemaker to begin delivering the largest version of its best-selling airplane.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Aviation Administration on Tuesday granted final approval to the long-delayed Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX 10, clearing the way for the US planemaker to begin delivering the largest version of its best-selling airplane. Boeing has said the MAX 10 will be a major driver of cash flow in its ongoing financial recovery following years of crises and controversies that slowed the company's timeline for the MAX 10. So far, airlines have ordered more than 1,550 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for 31% of Boeing's outstanding 737 backlog, according to IBA, an aviation analytics consultancy. The plane is critical to Boeing's fight with Airbus (AIR.PA) for orders in the lucrative single-aisle jetliner market, with China's COMAC C919 in a distant third place. "We want to beat the Europeans, we want to beat the Chinese," Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Tuesday at Boeing's plant in Everett, Washington, to tout the FAA certification. "But if we want to continue to do that, I have to allow you all to certify aircraft faster," Duffy said, a nod to his promise to streamline airplane certification. Boeing has been trying to certify the 737 MAX 10 since the early 2020s. Boeing shares closed down about 0.5%. In July, the company opened a new production line at the Everett plant to increase 737 output, which it also assembles in nearby Renton. Certification with Transport Canada and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency should be completed in "probably a couple months," said Boeing Commercial Airplanes Senior Vice President Mike Sinnett, who oversees development programs. Boeing can then deliver the first 737 MAX 10 to Canada-based airline WestJet, which is slated to happen early next year. The largest MAX 10 can hold up to 230 passengers, compared with up to 195 for the MAX 9 and 160 for the MAX 7. However, the delays have helped European rival Airbus' A321neo secure a greater share of the large single-aisle market. The bigger, higher-capacity plane is crucial to several airlines' growth plans. Major customers for the MAX 10 include United Airlines (UAL.O) , Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) , Ryanair (RYA.I) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and American Airlines (AAL.O) . The planemaker has already built a handful of MAX 10s awaiting delivery. Boeing has faced a more stringent certification process since two fatal MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019 killed 346 people. Scrutiny of the company's production and quality systems also increased after a January 2024 mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines MAX 9. The FAA in August approved the smaller 737 MAX 7 after a review that lasted more than eight years. The regulator required the MAX 10 to include significant improvements, including updates to the flight control system with an enhanced angle-of-attack sensor. Those will be applied to the existing fleet in the coming years. A problem with the anti-ice system on 737 MAX engines that arose in 2023 further delayed certification of the MAX 7 and 10. Boeing disclosed another glitch in late September with the latest update of the 737 MAX's navigation software, which threatened to further delay certification. However, the FAA determined it did not pose a safety concern and did not require Boeing to fix the problem as a condition of certifying the plane. Some of the 737 MAX certification team will now help Boeing get certification of the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production, which is six years behind schedule. The company has said it expects to complete certification and begin deliveries in 2027. Despite the long slog to certify the last 737 MAX variant, Boeing's Chris Payne, who oversaw the plane's certification program, struck an optimistic tone about speeding up the process. "And what's great is, you know, the administration's working seamlessly with the FAA and with Boeing, and we're all having the right dialog and conversations to be able to say what (does) the future look like and what (does) it need to look like," he said.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（20日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
続落して取引を終えた。銀行株や資源関連株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に続落。中型株で構成す...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（20日） 4:18 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。銀行株や資源関連株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に続落。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．０６％安だった。

英労働市場統計によると、賃金上昇ペースはわずかに加速し、雇用に回復の兆しが見られた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場ではイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めることがほぼ確実視されている。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は０．８４％安。金融大手ＨＳＢＣ、ナットウエスト、ロイズは０．９─１．１％下落した。

資源株指数は１．５９％下落。石油大手のＢＰは１．７％、シェルは０．８％それぞれ下落した。

一方、公益事業株指数は１．５２％高。電力・ガス供給のナショナル・グリッドは１．８％上昇した。住宅建設株指数は３．２９％高。

ＪＰモルガンが目標株価を引き上げたオンラインスーパー大手オカドは１０．０％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念などから、工業株の売り注文が優勢だった。フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．３８％安と続落。経済の停滞や財政悪化といった課題を抱えるフランスで、激しい抗議デモが発生。約半年後に大統領選を控えることもあり、投資家の警戒感が強まっている。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種工業株指数は１．４３％安。データセンター関連を顧客とするスイス重電大手ＡＢＢは５．０％安。機関投資家から資金調達を実施した配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは３．３％下落。

一方、フランスのクラウド事業者のＯＶＨクラウドは１８．０％高。財務指標が改善し、買われた。直近の四半期決算が増収だった電子機器メーカーのコメット・ホールディングは４．７％上昇した。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が今月の理事会で金利を据え置いた後、１２月会合で利上げを決めることが有力視されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

フランス国債利回りが２４年ぶりの高水準近辺で推移した。抗議デモの拡大懸念を背景に前日は約1カ月ぶりの大幅上昇を記録し、この日も荒い値動きが続いた。終盤には小幅低下した。

フランス１０年国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは終盤に３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８８％。一時４．９８７７％まで上昇し、２００２年７月以来の高水準となった１０月初旬の４．９９３７％に迫った。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は約２．５ｂｐ拡大し、１５０ｂｐとなった。この利回り格差は１０月初旬に１５８．６７ｂｐと、２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大していた。

ゴールドマン・サックスのストラテジストらは「直接的な経済への影響は当面限定的にとどまるとみているが、混乱がさらに広がる可能性は、金融環境の引き締まり、政治的不確実性の高まり、緊縮財政によって既に弱まっている経済に、新たな逆風をもたらす」と指摘した。

一方、ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ国債の利回りは低下したものの、最近のレンジ内にとどまった。エネルギー価格の上昇圧力が根強く、投資家は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の追加利上げ観測を後退させていない。

ドイツ１０年国債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３８５％。

政策金利見通しに敏感なドイツ２年国債利回りは５ｂｐ低下し、３．０４５％となった。

独伊１０年債利回り格差は１．５７ｂｐ縮小し、１０９．５ｂｐとなった。

item.title: トランプ氏、ウクライナに和平合意促す ロシア拘束の米国人巡る進展示唆
item.description:
Steve Holland Trevor Hunnicutt
[ワシントン ２０日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steve Holland　Trevor Hunnicutt

[ワシントン　２０日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２０日、ロシアとの戦争終結に向け、ウクライナに和平合意に応じるよう求めた。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスの大統領執務室で記者団に対し、「ウクライナはこの戦争を終わらせたいと望まなければならない」と述べた。また、「ウクライナがこの戦争を終わらせるときが来た」とし、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領が合意に応じることを望んでいると語った。

その上で、ロシアは戦場で優位に立っているとの認識を表明。「ロシアは巨大な機械のようなもので、ただ前進し続けており、実際にそうしてきた」とし、「ロシアは非常に広い領土を占領した」と述べた。

トランプ氏はまた、ロシアで拘束されている米国人の元教師、スティーブン・ハバード氏の問題について、ロシアのプーチン大統領と協議したと明らかにし、この件について近く進展がある可能性を示唆した。

トランプ氏は、ハバード氏に関する記者団の質問に対し「プーチン氏とこの件について話をしている」とし、「何が起きるか見ていてほしい。われわれはハバード氏の問題に集中して取り組んできた」と述べた。

ハバード氏は７４歳で、傭兵活動に関する罪で有罪判決を受けロシアの刑務所で約７年の刑に服している。米国務省はハバード氏の件を不当拘束と認定している。

ゼレンスキー大統領はこの日、ノルウェーの首都オスロで米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談。会談後の記者会見で、ロシアによる弾道ミサイル攻撃に関する情報共有や早期警戒の提供を米国が再開したことに謝意を示した。

ノルウェーのストーレ首相によると、ウィットコフ氏は２１日にロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクを訪問し、ロシア首脳部と会談する。

item.title: At least 17 data center campuses proposed on US public lands, group says
item.description: At least 35 data center-related applications covering more than 24,000 acres of US federal land are pending or active across six Western states, according to an analysis by conservation group Center for Western Priorities.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least 35 data center-related applications covering more than 24,000 acres of US federal land are pending or active across six Western states, according to an analysis by conservation group Center for Western Priorities. US Bureau of Land Management records show at least 17 proposed data center campuses and 13 related infrastructure projects, including transmission lines, pipelines, telecommunications facilities and access roads across Arizona, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Utah and Wyoming, according to the study. A map of the planned projects includes several applications for infrastructure tied to a Prometheus Hyperscale facility in Wyoming and a range of projects by developer Copia Power in Arizona, Nevada and Idaho, among others. The figures underscore industry interest in developing AI infrastructure on federal land as the Trump administration seeks to open public lands to a wider range of industrial uses, including energy, mining and technology projects. US President Donald Trump's administration has strongly [USN:L8N3ZL04J TEXT:"backed"] data center expansion as a national priority, but the public is increasingly [USN:L1N3WX0S4 TEXT:"opposed"] to such projects, citing concerns about electricity demand, water consumption, wildlife impacts and public access to federal lands. BLM officials were not immediately available for comment.

item.title: Three issues defining the 2026 US midterm elections
item.description: President Donald Trump’s record-low popularity, voter frustration over the cost of living and a fierce immigration fight are shaping the November 3 midterm elections, which will determine whether Republicans keep control of Congress or Democrats gain the power to challenge his administration.
item.dc:creator: Nolan Mccaskill
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump’s record-low popularity, voter frustration over the cost of living and a fierce immigration fight are shaping the November 3 midterm elections , which will determine whether Republicans keep control of Congress or Democrats gain the power to challenge his administration. Republicans hold narrow majorities in the House of Representatives and Senate. Democrats need a net gain of four seats to take control of each chamber. The outcome will hinge on a relatively small number of competitive races, but the campaigns are being shaped nationally by Trump himself and voter concerns over affordability and immigration. Here is a look at the three issues defining the election: DONALD TRUMP The president has put himself front and center in the closing stretch of the campaign cycle despite his record-low popularity, with upcoming rallies in Florida, Iowa, Michigan and Texas. Trump's approval rating has fallen to an all-time low 31%, according to a [USN:L6N465159 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"]. Yet he has repeatedly urged voters to pretend he's on the ballot, an effort that could motivate Democrats and independents to rally against his party despite the message being aimed at increasing turnout among Trump's base. Democrats have said Trump has broken his campaign promises to lower costs and end wars. They have vowed to tackle an affordability agenda to reduce Americans' cost of living and hold the administration accountable for alleged corruption if voters give them control of either chamber. AFFORDABILITY Voters have consistently ranked the cost of living as the top issue this election cycle. Half of registered voters surveyed in a recent Reuters/Ipsos poll cited the cost of living as the most important factor in how they will vote. In the same poll, voters highlighted healthcare, gasoline, food and housing as the top household bills lawmakers should focus on. Republicans' top legislative achievement was a tax cut extension that slashed roughly $1 trillion in spending for Medicaid, the government health insurance program for low-income Americans, and other health programs. Democrats last year forced a government shutdown over a failed effort to extend expiring health subsidies that benefited 24 million Americans. Gas prices have spiked since the US and Israel launched military strikes on Iran in February. The national average price of gas is $4.28 — $1.20 higher than it was a year ago, according to AAA. The average cost of diesel is $6.32 — a $2.70 increase from a year earlier. Grocery costs are up 1.8% over the past year, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics data on consumer prices. Federal Housing Finance Agency data show home prices rose 2.1% over the past year. Congress passed a bipartisan housing bill earlier this year. It became law without Trump's signature. IMMIGRATION Preliminary data from the Department of Homeland Security showed a 95% drop in migrants apprehended at the southwest border compared to former President Joe Biden's administration. The agency said there have been no Border Patrol releases the entire fiscal year for the first time ever. But fatal encounters with federal immigration agents have occurred in Maine, Minnesota and Texas. The backlash to the death of two US citizens in Minnesota pulled many Democrats in competitive primaries to the left this year, with some candidates calling for the impeachment of then-Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem and others saying Immigration and Customs Enforcement should be abolished. Democrats and Republicans sparred over immigration funding this year in a stalemate that forced Republicans to unilaterally pass a $70 billion bill to fund ICE and the Border Patrol for the remainder of Trump's presidency. Republicans counter Democrats' criticism by saying Democrats support open borders. Federal immigration officials also [USN:L1N45Y0CB TEXT:"raided the Washington home"] of Democratic US Representative Ilhan Omar of Minnesota this month, drawing widespread condemnation from Democrats. A person familiar with the case against Omar told Reuters one potential aim of the investigation could be to [USN:L6N46118Z TEXT:"strip her of US citizenship and deport her"]. OTHER ISSUES Artificial intelligence and data centers, cryptocurrency, abortion and Israel could also influence voters in individual races. In Ohio's Senate race, for example, Democratic nominee Sherrod Brown has labeled Republican Senator Jon Husted the face of data centers, and the crypto super PAC Defend American Jobs has spent more than $46 million to reelect Husted over Brown, a former US senator who chaired the chamber's Banking Committee. In Maine's Senate race, Democratic nominee Troy Jackson is hoping voters don't forget that Republican Senator Susan Collins helped confirm Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court, which later overturned the federal right to abortion. Collins is on the election ballot for the first time since the high court made abortion a state issue rather than a federal right. In Michigan, Republican nominee Mike Rogers has indicated he would accept help from a pro-Israel super PAC that spent more than $30 million backing Democratic US Representative Haley Stevens in her unsuccessful primary against Abdul El-Sayed, who now faces Rogers in the general election. The group has already spent more than $280,000 on mailers against El-Sayed. Earlier this week, Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection.

item.title: EQT in advanced talks to buy testing firm Qiagen, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: European molecular testing company Qiagen is in advanced talks to be acquired by Swedish buyout firm EQT , Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: European molecular testing company Qiagen (QIA.DE) is in advanced talks to be acquired by Swedish buyout firm EQT (EQTAB.ST) , Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. US-listed shares of Qiagen were up over 6% in afternoon trading. The company has a market capitalization of €8.57 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Qiagen's board is meeting this week to decide on the potential deal, the report said, citing people familiar with the talks. There is no certainty the discussions will lead to a sale to EQT or another buyer, the report added. EQT has submitted a binding offer of more than $50 per share for Qiagen, while US private equity firm KKR has also made a bid, Bloomberg News reported. The reported talks come after Qiagen said [USN:L4N3YL1R1 TEXT:"in January"] it was evaluating strategic options amid renewed takeover interest. Interest in the diagnostics company continued through the year, with buyout firms including EQT, Advent and KKR linked to a potential acquisition in July. Barclays analyst Luke Sergott said the latest Bloomberg report suggests a deal appears "more likely" and that he continues to see "a good possibility that a deal goes through." Sergott reiterated his $55 price target on Qiagen. Qiagen develops molecular testing and sample-preparation technologies used by research and clinical laboratories. KKR declined to comment, while EQT did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. Qiagen said it does not comment on "market rumors or speculation." ($1 = 0.9259 euros)

item.title: iFood compra empresa de benefícios Caju e dobra presença no setor de vales-alimentação
item.description: O iFood, aplicativo de entrega de comida controlado pela investidora holandesa Prosus , anunciou nesta terça-feira a compra da Caju, empresa de benefícios corporativos e atuante no mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação.
item.dc:creator: Luciana Novaes Magalhaes
item.content:encoded: O iFood, aplicativo de entrega de comida controlado pela investidora holandesa Prosus (PRX.AS) , anunciou nesta terça-feira a compra da Caju, empresa de benefícios corporativos e atuante no mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação. Com a compra da Caju o iFood busca crescer além do seu serviço principal de entregas, mirando também segmento de benefícios a funcionários. O iFood domina o setor de delivery no Brasil, que hoje vive um acirramento da concorrência , após a chegada da Keeta, unidade do gigante chinês de tecnologia Meituan (3690.HK) . Se aprovada pelos órgãos reguladores locais, a aquisição dobrará a presença do iFood no setor de benefícios corporativos, disseram as empresas em um comunicado conjunto. Os termos financeiros do negócio, realizado por meio do iFood Benefícios, braço de benefícios corporativos do iFood, não foram divulgados. No entanto, a aquisição faz parte do plano mais amplo do iFood de investir R$24 bilhões até março de 2027, informou o comunicado. O crescente mercado de vales-refeição e vales-alimentação do Brasil movimenta cerca de R$150 bilhões por ano entre mais de 20 milhões de consumidores, de acordo com Arthur Freitas, CEO do iFood Benefícios. O iFood Benefícios e a Caju processam, cada um, cerca de R$1,3 bilhão em transações mensais, disse Freitas à Reuters em entrevista. Juntas, as duas empresas atenderão aproximadamente 135 mil clientes corporativos e 3 milhões de usuários ativos, acrescentou. O negócio ainda depende da aprovação do Banco Central e do Cade, com conclusão prevista para o próximo ano, segundo Eduardo Del Giglio, cofundador e CEO da Caju.

item.description: [ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行）のグリーン金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）委員は２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英中銀グリーン委員、利上げを主張　「インフレ加速リスク想定以上」 3:23 配信

英ロンドンのイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）前で９月撮影。REUTERS/Corey Rudy

[ロンドン ２０日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行）のグリーン金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）委員は２０日、イラン戦争に伴うエネルギー価格ショックから広範なインフレが加速するリスクは、英中銀の予想を上回っていると述べ、利上げが必要だとの見解を改めて示した。

グリーン氏は、ロンドン・スクール・オブ・エコノミクス（ＬＳＥ）での演説原稿で、エネルギーショックによるいわゆる「二次的波及効果」がより強いと想定して行動し、必要に応じて後から政策を調整する方が望ましいと指摘。

「したがって、私は引き続き『二次的波及効果』のリスクに対して先手を打って対処すべきだと考えている」と述べた。

グリーン氏はＭＰＣの中で、利上げに賛成票を投じてきた少数派の一員。

item.title: WWE, McMahons must face sex abuse claims by former 'ring boys'
item.description: A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Wiessner
item.content:encoded: A federal judge has denied a bid by World Wrestling Entertainment and former executives Vince and Linda McMahon to dismiss a lawsuit claiming they are liable for years of alleged sexual abuse suffered by teenage "ring boys" in the 1980s and 1990s. US District Judge James Bredar in Baltimore on Monday rejected claims that a 2023 Maryland law allowing the plaintiffs to sue over decades-old allegations violated the US Constitution and the defendants' right to due process. The eight anonymous plaintiffs say in the 2024 lawsuit that they were recruited by ringside announcer Melvin Phillips to work as part-time crew members and were abused by him and two other officials at WWE, then known as WWF. Phillips and the other alleged abusers died years before the plaintiffs filed the lawsuit. WWE and lawyers for Vince McMahon and Linda McMahon, the current US Secretary of Education, did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday. Greg Gutzler, a lawyer for the plaintiffs, said Maryland's law recognizes that "trauma does not follow a legal deadline." “This ruling is a significant victory for our clients and for other survivors of childhood sexual abuse who have waited years for the opportunity to seek justice,” Gutzler, of plaintiffs' firm DiCello Levitt, said in a statement. The Maryland law eliminated a seven-year statute of limitations for sex abuse claims involving minors, which had been extended from three years in 2003. It was part of a wave of state laws adopted after the #MeToo movement allowing sex abuse claims previously blocked by statutes of limitations to proceed, in some cases temporarily. The plaintiffs in their lawsuit accused WWE and the McMahons of negligence and negligent hiring and retention, and are seeking unspecified damages. Vince McMahon, who built WWF into a cultural force in the 1980s after purchasing its predecessor from his father, [USN:L1N3EH03B TEXT:"resigned from the organization"] in 2024 amid separate claims of sex trafficking and assault, which [USN:FWN3O60QP TEXT:"he has denied"]. Linda McMahon, his estranged wife, was [USN:L1N3P316M TEXT:"appointed US Secretary of Education"] by President Donald Trump last year after heading the US Small Business Administration during Trump's first term. She and Vince McMahon have previously denied having knowledge of alleged abuse of ring boys. The defendants argued that Maryland's law violated the US Constitution's ban on retroactive, or ex post facto, laws, and that it violated the Constitution's guarantee of due process as applied to them. They said it could be difficult or impossible to mount a defense as witnesses become unavailable, memories fade and other evidence is lost. But Bredar on Monday said the law served a legitimate purpose of addressing the barriers that child sex abuse victims face in court, and that the concerns raised by WWE were overblown. "Plaintiffs can make a case by producing at least some material facts to contest, documents to dispute, and witnesses to cross-examine," the judge wrote. The Maryland Supreme Court last year rejected arguments that the law violated the state's constitution, which Bredar on Monday said had raised distinct issues from the former ring boys' case. But the top courts in several other states including Maine, Utah and Kentucky have said in recent years that similar laws were invalid because expired statutes of limitations are not reversible. The case is Doe v. World Wrestling Entertainment, US District Court for the District of Maryland, No. 1:24-cv-03487. For the plaintiffs: William Murphy of Murphy Falcon & Murphy; Adam Prom and others from DiCello Levitt For WWE: Daniel Toal and others from Paul Weiss Rifkind Wharton & Garrison; Linda Woolf of Goodell DeVries Leech & Dann For Vince McMahon: Christopher Jeffries of Kramon & Graham For Linda McMahon: William Murphy and Samantha Kavanagh of Zuckerman Spaeder Read more: [USN:L1N3EH03B TEXT:"Vince McMahon resigns from TKO, WWE over sex assault lawsuit"] [USN:L1N3P316M TEXT:"Trump's pick for education chief, Linda McMahon, defends plans to unwind the department"] [USN:FWN3O60QP TEXT:"Former WWE CEO Vince McMahon settles with SEC over undisclosed settlements with women"]

FAST

Oct 20 : SpaceX shareholders want to know when the rocket maker will merge with Tesla, bringing together two of Elon Musk's biggest companies in a union that investors have long speculated about. "When will SpaceX merge with Tesla?" was the second-most upvoted question — drawing 26 upvotes — submitted by investors to SpaceX management ahead of its third-quarter earnings webcast on Tuesday. The same question received 128 upvotes on the Tesla investor relations site.  Barclays suggested last week that a deal could be announced before Tesla's annual meeting, with SpaceX the likelier acquirer, though neither company nor Musk has officially committed to favoring a deal. LUNAR LANDER PROGRESS QUESTIONED
